action: Formalized the complementary-minor entropy lemma in Dittert/Entropy.lean with the helper modules Dittert/Entropy/Algebra.lean, AMGM.lean and Minor.lean on top of the floors modules and the ported GurvitsPort development: the weighted row form of the matrix extended by one column of entries q_i t_i, whose reduction (derivative in the new variable at zero) is the sum over rows of q_i t_i times the row form of the minor M(i|j), with top coefficient the sum of q_i t_i per M(i|j) (the Laplace expansion along a column appears as a by-product); H-stability of that reduction from the floors module's closure lemmas; two weighted AM-GM steps (weights q_i over the rows, then the row entries divided by 1 - q_i) bounding the capacity below by prod t_i^(q_i) prod (1 - q_i)^(1 - q_i); positivity of the minor's permanent whenever q_i > 0 by Birkhoff's decomposition; the port's Gurvits bound for the reduced polynomial; and the choice t_i = 1/d_i when q_i > 0, t_i = 1 otherwise, which rearranges to the claim with the real-power convention 0^0 = 1; installed the frozen project and ran the controlled formal check of Dittert.core_entropy.
